frontmatter.name: graphify
frontmatter.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

frontmatter.name: claritas-prompts
frontmatter.description: Leaked system prompts from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Replit, and 25+ AI tools. Use when building AI agents, optimizing system prompts, or understanding how major AI tools work. Trigger on: system prompt, agent config, AI behavior, prompt engineering, leaked prompts, ai-prompts.

frontmatter.name: archify
frontmatter.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technic
